<script>
// Simple password protection for NCURA workshop page
(function() {
  const correctPassword = "CostaMesa2025"; // Change this to your desired password

  if (sessionStorage.getItem('ncura_authenticated') !== 'true') {
    const password = prompt('This page requires a password. Please enter it to continue:');

    if (password === correctPassword) {
      sessionStorage.setItem('ncura_authenticated', 'true');
    } else {
      document.body.innerHTML = '<div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100vh; font-family: sans-serif;"><div style="text-align: center;"><h1>Access Denied</h1><p>Incorrect password. This page is restricted to workshop participants only.</p></div></div>';
      document.body.style.margin = '0';
    }
  }
})();
</script>

::: {.text-center}
# NCURA Regional Conference Workshop
:::

## Workshop Overview

Welcome to the NCURA Regional Conference Workshop! This page contains resources and information for attendees participating in the Vandalizer workshop.

### Access the Workshop Instance

**[Click here to access the Vandalizer workshop instance →](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/){target="_blank"}**

::: {.callout-important}
**IMPORTANT - Keep this link open in your browser during the workshop!**

The workflow sharing links below will only work if you have the Vandalizer instance open in another tab or window. Additionally, these workflows are configured specifically for this instance and will only function during the conference period (available for the next 4 days).
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
**Security Note**: These instances run on University of Idaho infrastructure and access cloud services. **Please do not upload sensitive information.**
:::

### Learn More About Vandalizer

Interested in implementing Vandalizer at your institution? Visit **[AI4RA at University of Idaho](https://ai4ra.uidaho.edu/){target="_blank"}** to sign up for updates, learn more about the project, and explore what the University of Idaho and Southern Utah University are up to.

---

## Test Files

The following test files are provided to allow for low-risk experimentation with the Vandalizer system:

1. **[Sample NOFO](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_NOFO.pdf){download="Sample_NOFO.pdf"}**
   - A Notice of Funding Opportunity document showing typical grant announcement requirements and guidelines

2. **[Sample Grant](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_Grant.pdf){download="Sample_Grant.pdf"}**
   - A completed grant proposal demonstrating standard sections and formatting

3. **[Sample Budget](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_Budget.xlsx){download="Sample_Budget.xlsx"}**
   - A budget spreadsheet with line items and budget justification

4. **[Sample RFA](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Pilot%20Grant%20RFA.pdf){download="Pilot Grant RFA.pdf"}**
   - A Request for Application document outlining submission requirements and evaluation criteria

5. **[Award Announcement](https://github.com/ui-insight/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/award_announcement.pdf){download="award_announcement.pdf"}**
   - An award notice detailing funding amounts, terms, and compliance requirements

---

## Sample Workflows

Once you've signed in, you can add the following test workflows to your workspace by clicking the links below. Each workflow demonstrates different capabilities of Vandalizer:

1. **[RFA Checklist Maker](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fc38476292df6997bb5c){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: RFA
   - Output: A structured checklist with key information extracted from an RFA

2. **[Award Notice Compliance Analysis](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fde8476292df6997bb69){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: Federal Award Notices
   - Output: A post-award summary that synthesizes all compliance terms and financial requirements into a single, structured 'Compliance & Financial Overview' document

3. **[Federal Financial Report (FFR) Requirements](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fe56476292df6997bb6f){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: Federal Award Notices
   - Output: An actionable guide that isolates all FFR and financial reporting obligations

4. **[Subaward Summary Generator](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fec5476292df6997bb74){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: Federal Award Notice
   - Output: An actionable guide that isolates all FFR and financial reporting obligations, detailing submission schedules, systems, required data, and compliance rules

5. **[Prior Approval Requirements Tracking Summary](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906ff64476292df6997bb7e){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: Federal Award Notice
   - Output: A comprehensive tracking summary that isolates prior approval requirements
